  Owner of the project? Troubleshoot following things:

-
      [Retry](/retry/io.jsonwebtoken/jjwt-root/0.13.0)this version.
      Sometimes it's just a matter of time to pick up new versions.
- Is the jjwt-root-0.13.0-javadoc.jar actually distributed to either maven or bintray?
- Does the jjwt-root-0.13.0-javadoc.jar file contains an index.html in the extracted root folder? (you can rename .jar to .zip to extract the file)

    ](https://github.com/maxcellent/javadoc.io/issues)
  if you tried everything but still doesn't work.

io.jsonwebtoken:jjwt:0.13.0.
  Please try other versions.

  Owner of the project? Troubleshoot following things:

-
      [Retry](/retry/io.jsonwebtoken/jjwt/0.13.0)this version.
      Sometimes it's just a matter of time to pick up new versions.
- Is the jjwt-0.13.0-javadoc.jar actually distributed to either maven or bintray?
- Does the jjwt-0.13.0-javadoc.jar file contains an index.html in the extracted root folder? (you can rename .jar to .zip to extract the file)

[
    ](https://github.com/maxcellent/javadoc.io/issues)
  if you tried everything but still doesn't work.

Source: https://javadoc.io/task/sync_latest/io.jsonwebtoken/jjwt

No JavaDoc is released for artifact

io.jsonwebtoken:jjwt:0.13.0.
  Please try other versions.

  Owner of the project? Troubleshoot following things:

-
      [Retry](/retry/io.jsonwebtoken/jjwt/0.13.0)this version.
      Sometimes it's just a matter of time to pick up new versions.
- Is the jjwt-0.13.0-javadoc.jar actually distributed to either maven or bintray?
- Does the jjwt-0.13.0-javadoc.jar file contains an index.html in the extracted root folder? (you can rename .jar to .zip to extract the file)

[
    ](https://github.com/maxcellent/javadoc.io/issues)
  if you tried everything but still doesn't work.
